༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i dbang gi tho yig bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i dbang gi tho yig bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i dbang gi tho yig ni/ sa chog dang*/ sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa/ lha sta gon du gnas pa rnams dkyil 'khor spyis rigs 'gre zhing*/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten na sa'i lha mo sta gon mi dgos/ lha sta gon yang med pas rung ba tsam yin mod kyi/ byas na legs so/ / de bskyed tshul ni/ gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa bskyed nas/ tshom bu rnams skad cig gis lha so sor bskyed/ ye shes pa stim/ dbang bskur ba mi mdzad/ mchod bstod snyan gsan dbab pa rnams bya'o/ /bum pa mgul 'ching sngon po can bya/ rnam rgyal bum pa bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang dang*/ de nang du lha yongs rdzogs skad cig gis bskyed la/ go cha bgo /ye shes pa stim/ dbang bskur/ mchod bstod bzlas pa bdud rtsir bzhu ba rnams bya/ las bum gyi nang du phyag na rdo rje yab rkyang zhig bskyed pa la/ go skon pa la sogs pa gong bzhin/ a mṛ ta 'i sngags bzla/ bdud rtsir bzhu ba mi dgos so/ / slob ma sta gon la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa bskyed du gzhug pa/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ spro ba bskyed pa/ so shing*/ khyor chu/ srung skud/ ku sha sbyin pa/ rmi lam brtag pa rnams spyi dang mtshungs/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ thal mo sbyar nas rjes zlos bya ste/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' che/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /deng nas bzung ste mgon med bdag /byang chub snying po ma thob bar/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa chen po las/ /bdag dang 'gro ba skyabs pa'i phyir/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo sku gsum bdag /chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi/ /'dod chags bral zhing mya ngan 'das/ /zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi/ /tshogs kyi mchog gyur dge 'dun te/ /phyir mi ldog la skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo rnal 'byor tshogs/

/mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ /stong pa snying rje dbyer med pa/ /gnyug ma'i sems la skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gi lus dang ngag yid kyis/ /sngon chad sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /mgon po khyod kyi spyan sngar bshags/ / slad chad sdig pa mi bgyid pas/ /deng nas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi/ khyed kyi slab bya rjes su slob/ khyed kyi bka' las mi 'da' bas/ /kun nas yongs su skyabs su gsol/ / ces lan gsum brjod/ de nas rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung ba ni spyi dang mtshungs/ de nas zab mo'i chos bshad pa'i sgo nas spro ba bskyed du gzhug pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum ba ra'i me tog bzhin/ /res 'ga' 'byung ngam mi 'byung srid/ /rgya lam la ni res 'ga' 'byung*/ /gsang sngags spyod tshul 'byung ba ni/ /de dag pas kyang shin tu dkon/ /gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'di/ / sems can sangs rgyas byed pa'o/ / zhes so/ / sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor mchod de nam mkhar 'degs pa dang*/ rdul tshon gyi phyogs la/ thig tshon byin rlabs/ dkyil 'khor 'bri zhing rgyan bkram pa sogs spyi khyab kyi rigs 'gre zhing*/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ bdag bskyed sngon du song bas/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ lha la dbang bskur ba'i bar/ phal cher bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ gtso 'khor thams cad sa bon kho na las bskyed pa dang*/ gtso bo la lus dkyil khyung lnga las mi byed pa dang*/ ye shes sems dpa'i sngon du sta gon gyi lha bsre ba ni khyad par ro/ /de nas mchod bstod gtor ma dang bcas pa rgyas par bya/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bdag 'jug gis rjes la btang kyang rung ngo*/ /yig brgyas nyams chags bkang*/ slob ma la bskur ba ltar bdag 'jug blang la/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu blangs/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsol ba btab/ mig dar btang*/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung byas/

lag tu me tog gtad la/ zla ba rdo rje'i sems bskyed ma thag tu/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi hūṃ zhes brjod pas/ slob ma phyag na rdo rjer gyur pa la/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ de nas gsang gdams spyi dang 'dra/ deng nyid rdo rje gtum po bdag khyod kyis snying la yang dag zhugs/ / zhes sogs dang*/ bla ma'i bka' nyan pa dang*/ chu blud pa'i sgo nas kyang dam la bzhag /de nas yol ba'i nang du bcug la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma zhugs par bgyi/ / sgo rang phye nas/ nang du zhugs/ khyung lnga'i thugs ka nas so so'i phyag mtshan spros te/ slob ma'i gnas lngar stim/ phyogs bzhi nas phyag gsum gsum bya ste/ oṃ na ma te hūṃ/ zhes sogs kyis so/ / 'di'i rjes zlos/ gsang ba brtan pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ rig pa'i me tog 'di phul bas/ /sngon tshe ye shes bsnyen pa'i lha/ /gang yin de la 'bab par shog / ces me tog 'dor/ ye shes dbab pa'i don du gsol ba btab/ spyi bor bla ma me ri'i nang du bzhugs pa nad gdon bsreg pa dang*/ nam mkha' nas bya khyung mang po cu ru ru byung*/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang khengs/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas ye shes sems dpa' dpag tu med pa byung nas/ slob ma la bstim/ oṃ a pe sha ya/ du ri ma nu ra ri/ a pe sha ya a pe sha ya/ staṃ bha ya staṃ bha ya/ ru ru tsa le hūṃ/ a pe du hūṃ/ ha ṣe swāhā/ zhes rol mo'i sgra bya zhing me tog gtor/ de nas brtan par bya ba/ kha dog 'dri ba/ mig dar 'grol ba rnams bya/ ltos shig ltos shig 'di la ltos/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /khyod ni rdo rje gtum po'i rigs/ /skal ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam/ /de nas lha ngo rgyas par bstan/ /de nas rnam dag bstan pa ni/ /dbus su phur bus btab pa ni/ / dran pa'o/ / thig skud ni tshangs pa'i gnas bzhi'o/

/lha dang lha mo ni dpe/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /pad+ma ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /ze'u 'bru ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /sna tshogs rdo rje ni 'phrin las bzhi ston pa'o/ /sgo bzhi ni tshad med bzhi/ mtshon sna lnga ni ye shes lnga/ /'khor lo rtsibs brgyad ni rnam rtog gcod pa lte ba mthing ga chos kyi sku/ sa bon dang phyag mtshan ni longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ khyung rnams sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku'o/ / yang na mngon rtogs nas 'byung ba bzhin ston kyang rung*/ de nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rje gsol ba btab/ /slob ma gtso bor sgom du bcug /sangs rgyas rnams kyi bum pa'i dbang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab bsgrubs pa/ /de ring khyod la bskur bar bya/ /bum pa'i dbang 'di khyod kyi long*/ /bla ma mi bskyod pa yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas/ /dbang lha dpag tu med pa sprul/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis dang*/ /ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi dbang skur/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ slob ma rnam snang gi nga rgyal 'khyud rgya byar gzhug /rdor dril spyi bor bzung la/ gang gang gnang ba de dang de/ /phyag na rdo rje rang nyid gtso/ /gang phyir chos rnams rnam dag pa/ / sangs rgyas ye shes rin chen nyid/ /oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ ming 'dogs/ rin chen 'byung ldan du bskyed pa'i dbu rgyan skon la/ rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa traṃ/ rdo rje gtum po snang ba mtha' yas su bskyed pa'i/ rdo rje gtad la/ de ring sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje'i dbang 'di khyod kyis long*/ /oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣañtsa hrīḥ de nas don grub tu bskyed pa'i dril bu gtad la/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi/

/shes rab dbyangs/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ de nas slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ rdo rje can khyod bka' drin gyis/ / de ring bdag la bstsal du gsol/ / zhes gsol ba btab/ rdo rje che sogs dang*/ de ring dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyur nas/ sngags la sbyor gyi bar dang spyi dang mthun par mda' gzhu sbyin/ 'khor lo dung po ti rnams gtad la/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa/ / zhes pa nas/ rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ / ces pa'i bar brjod/ de nas de kho na nyid gsum bzung ba spyi dang 'dra/ slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te/ rdo rje sems pas dbu brgyan/ rjes gnang la/ mig thur/ me long*/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad/ sngags kyi zlas lung rnams bya zhing*/ lung bstan dang*/ gsang chen mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ / sogs dbugs dbyung ba dang*/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yis/ / sogs dam tshig bsgrags pa dang*/ gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyi ni/ / zhes pa nas/ 'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas/ / zhes pa'i bar gyi gzengs bstod rnams bya ste/ bum dbang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ byang chub rdo rjes gsol ba btab/ gsang dbang ngo bo spyi dang mthun/ sher dbang la/ maṇ+ḍal gsol btab gong bzhin/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma sogs kyis rig ma gtad/ zhal sbyor du 'dug par mos/ slob ma'i gnas lngar khyung rigs lnga'i thugs kar yang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan ye shes lnga'i me 'bar ba bskyed/ des dug lnga bsregs/ byang sems zhu bas dga' bzhi thob par mos/ dbang bzhi pa la maṇ+ḍal gsol btab gong dang 'dra/ 'dzin pa gang yang med pa ru/ /rang bzhin med pa'i ngang la bzhag /sems nyid ma bcos gnyug ma ru/ /shes pa bzhi pa'i don yin gsung*/ zhes pa'o/ / dbang gong ma gsum la mig dar bcings 'grol mi mdzad kun gyi mtha' rten cod pan gyi dbang ni/ me tog 'phreng ba spyi bor gtugs te/ hūṃ me tog gang la lhung gyur cing*/ / bskal ba du mar rab sgrub pa/

/las dang skal bar 'dzoms pa yi/ /cod pan 'phreng ba'i dngos grub longs/ / gnyis pa dngos grub kyi dbang ni/ bdud rtsi lan gsum du blud la/ hūṃ skye med sku la brjod bral gsung*/ /rtog med thugs kyi dngos grub bstsol/ / gsum pa slob dpon du byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ gdugs dang rol mor bcas te dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum du byas nas/ sngags dang brgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ /slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ / zhes pa'o/ /slob ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba ni/ spyi dang mthun no/ /mda' gzhu dang chos bshad dang*/ sngags kyi rjes gnang ma gtogs/ mig thur nas gzengs bstod kyi bar/ gzhan nas kha bskang bar gnang bas/ lugs 'di la med kyang chog pa 'dra zhing*/ gzhan nas kha bskang ba/ gzhan yang phra mo snang mod kyi/ de dag ni dgos par mngon no/ /zhes pa gsang bdag gtum po ras chung lugs kyi dbang gi tho yig 'di ni/ rje btsun bla ma dam pa mchog gi skyes mchog dpal stag lung ngag gis dbang po'i bka' gnang ste/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// // bkra shis// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/phyag na rdo rje gtum po'i dbang gi tho yig bzhugs/ - PAGE 328 -- PAGE 331 -- PAGE 327 -
